scope: SHA2/SHAKE128f lean screen;20 calls on2 disjoint warmup keys;10 distinct measured keys once/process;two balanced independent process pairs per comparison;timing and allocation separate;no steady-state claim.

followup.selection: Evaluate each address/buffer mechanism separately against stock. Advance if any targeted128f operation shows both pairs with lower allocation and no targeted128f cell shows a clear latency regression, OR any targeted128f operation has repeatable latency improvement. Clear regression means wall and thread CPU each exceed stock by more than2% in both pairs. Repeatable improvement means wall and thread CPU each fall by at least2% in both pairs. Address targets are keygen/sign; buffer targets include verification. Keep all initial losers and explicitly label confirmation as selected. Never combine mechanisms. Compare selected buffer peeling to both stock and old buffer.
followup.limits: Selection thresholds are screening rules,not significance tests; unchanged address-verification controls remain visible. All four192/256f configurations run for every selected mechanism.
